```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(magick)

rm(list = ls())

take_first_link <- function(link) {
    link[1]
}

#Process images from imported dataset and convert them to pngs (all in vector_pics array)
pit_data <- read.csv("pit_scouting_mdbet.csv")

# with a function that takes the first link in each row of the column 
# instead of just the first row
pit_data <- pit_data |>
    mutate(Upload.robot.photo = sapply(strsplit(Upload.one.ISOMETRIC.robot.photo, ', '), take_first_link))


# taking links and converting them to images
pic_link <- pit_data$Upload.one.ISOMETRIC.robot.photo
# pics_link <- gsub("open\\?id=", "uc?export=download&id=", pic_link)
pit_data$Timestamp <- NULL

heic_download <- function(link) {
    downloadable <- gsub("open\\?id=", "uc?export=download&id=", link)
    
    unname(downloadable)
}


jpeg_download <- function(link) {
    downloadable <- gsub("file/d/", "uc?export=download&id=", link)
    downloadable <- gsub("/view", "", downloadable)
    
    downloadable
}

convert_to_download <- function(link) {
    if (grepl("open", link)) {
    return(heic_download(link))
        } else if (grepl("view", link)) {
            return(jpeg_download(link))
        } else {
                return(NA)
            }
}

# im genuinely so lost

pics_link <- sapply(pic_link, convert_to_download, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

# colnames(pit_data) <- c("team_num","scout_initials", "weight", "length", "width", "height", "drive_base", "hopper_length","hopper_width", "hopper_height", "hopper_capacity", "robot_photo","turret", "current_issues", "battery_type", "num_batteries", "elec_quality","build_quality", "add_comments")

default_image <- image_read("default_image.png")
#convert to vector and apply image_read on every img in pics_link

whomp_whomp <- function(link) {
    tryCatch(
        {
            image_read(link)
            },
        error = function(e) {
            return(NULL)
        })
    }

vector_pics <- lapply(pics_link, whomp_whomp) 


write_pit_pics <- function(pit_data) { 
if (!dir.exists("/Users/rosyyu/Documents/R/scouting2026/shinyapp/data/chcmp/images")) dir.create("/Users/rosyyu/Documents/R/scouting2026/shinyapp/data/chcmp/images")
for (i in seq_along(vector_pics)) {
    if (is.null(vector_pics[[i]])) {
      next
    }
  path = file.path("/Users/rosyyu/Documents/R/scouting2026/shinyapp/data/chcmp/images", paste0(pit_data$Team.number..for.the.team.you.re.scouting.[i], ".png"))
  if (path == "NA.png") { 
    path = paste0("default_image",".png")
    print(path)
    next}
  else {
    image_write(
        vector_pics[[i]],
        path = path,
        format = "png")}
    print(path)
}
}
write_pit_pics(pit_data)
```
